annotations.title: Set up the phone over USB

description: Set up CodeDroid on the Android phone plugged into this computer (USB or Wireless debugging), then pair this computer with it, with no code to type: installs the app from get.codedroid.com if it is missing (only with install: true), turns on its Accessibility and keyboard over adb, waits for the user to sign in on the phone, and pairs. Call it when codedroid_status says this computer is not paired. If CodeDroid is not on the phone yet, it says so: ask the user before calling again with install: true. A long setup answers "still working": call it again to keep waiting. Once paired, the user taps Allow on the phone; then call codedroid_status.

install.description: Install CodeDroid if it is missing. Only once the user has agreed.

serial.description: adb serial of the phone (adb devices), when several devices are on adb
